questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.

A) Only after the rain stopped did they continue the journey.
B) Only after the rain stopped they continued the journey.
C) Only after the rain stopped, they continued the journey.
D) Only after the rain stopped, did they continue the journey.
options: Only after the rain stopped did they continue the journey.
Only after the rain stopped they continued the journey.
Only after the rain stopped, they continued the journey.
Only after the rain stopped, did they continue the journey.
questions.answer: Only after the rain stopped did they continue the journey.

options: It was in the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.
It was the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.
It was in the old library where the historian found the rare manuscript.

questions.answer: It was in the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation.

A) If I were you, I would accept the offer.
B) If I was you, I would accept the offer.
C) If I had been you, I would accept the offer.
D) If I had been you, I should accept the offer.
options: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
If I was you, I would accept the offer.
If I had been you, I would accept the offer.
If I had been you, I should accept the offer.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would accept the offer.

A) The report, which was delayed due to technical issues, has now been submitted.
B) The report was delayed because of technical issues, and now it has been submitted.
C) The report, because of technical issues, was delayed, but now it has been submitted.
D) The report was delayed because of technical issues, and now it has been submitted, so we can proceed with the analysis.
options: The report, which was delayed due to technical issues, has now been submitted.
The report was delayed because of technical issues, and now it has been submitted.
The report, because of technical issues, was delayed, but now it has been submitted.

questions.answer: The report, which was delayed due to technical issues, has now been submitted.
